newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Dec T-bond poised for break to upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dec T-bond poised for break to upside.

text.p: U.S. debt futures are poised for a strong upwards break although fundamental data may be required to start the process, some technical analysts believe.
"Technically the market's ready to break out; we just need the data," said Larry Berman, senior technical analyst with Technical Data.
"The set-up's there, we need the gas to do it. The market's not going to break out by itself and if it does it's not going to be sustained," he said.

Berman said a MACD (Moving Average Convergence-Divergence) study of the weekly chart for December T-bond futures shows an increase in short-term momentum, which is very bullish for the contract in the near-term.
"Momentum is primed to diverge bullishly," he said.
However, the fact that the contract has repeatedly challenged resistance between 111-26/32 and 111-28/32 suggests that fundamental data may be required to help the market upwards, he said.
Similarly, bearish fundamental data could push the market below support at 109-26/32, he said.
A slide below support at 110-00 would mean the contract is not yet ready to exit a consolidative period but would not negate the long-term bull trend, he said.

Similarly, March eurodollars could be poised for gains to 94.60 or 94.70, he said, noting that the contract has already moved above its August highs and has been consolidating for two weeks. However, a drop below 94.18 could mean further consolidation, he said.

Berman said he expects the contract to hold within a 10-point range until it's given a reason, in the form of fundamental data, to move higher. -Danielle Bochove (312)408-8750,E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
